samples.text: One of my deepest joys comes from equipping creative people with the visual tools they need to further their work.
"Webflow changed my life, empowering me to become a developer. Now I'm helping to evolve the Webflow brand."
"My work on aro won an Awwwards SOTD, Dev Award, and CSSDA Site of the day."
"I developed a visual language that combines community stories with the abstract nature of market forces."
"Equipped with a gorgeous color palette and a new 3d visual language, I designed a new site that shows off Overflow's compelling visual identity."

I started making websites in 2013. I’ve learned a lot. Most of those learnings came from doing the wrong thing. It’s the curse of any creative that as soon as a project is done, you realize all the ways you could have done things better.
I’ve (mostly) learned to be ok with that, to come to expect it, and to carry those learnings with me into the next project. Let me share some of those learnings with you.
